content.title: College Spotlight: Carnegie Mellon University
content.text: Fresh off her recent visit to Carnegie Mellon University, Jodi Glou, President of Custom College Consulting, shares her firsthand account of the dynamic energy and innovation that define this world-renowned institution. Located in Pittsburgh, PA, CMU is celebrated for its interdisciplinary excellence and collaborative culture. Students apply directly to one of seven colleges, including the prestigious School of Computer Science, the College of Engineering, the Tepper School of Business, and the College of Fine Arts—each offering top-tier programs and hands-on learning opportunities. From cutting-edge research in robotics, cybersecurity, and human-computer interaction to a thriving entrepreneurial spirit that’s launched companies like Duolingo and ModCloth, CMU fosters a future-focused environment. Jodi was especially impressed by the vibrant student life, with over 400 student organizations, Division III athletics, and signature traditions like the Spring Carnival and Buggy Races. Set in a growing tech hub, CMU provides unparalleled access to real-world impact and industry connections. With its selective admissions and a culture that values creativity, leadership, and innovation, Carnegie Mellon prepares students to lead across disciplines—from AI to the arts.
